COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)

   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team

   B. Run with the tool
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Cybersecurity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
